memory: I found that at 15 cm and 5 Hz, short high-amplitude bursts (25% and 50% duty holding mean 0.8 L/min) prevent the anchored off-axis recirculation, while longer duty (75%) permits it. Peak amplitude and ON-time both control vortex anchoring; pulses produce high instantaneous shear spikes but reduce low-frequency sustained flow that fosters the eddy. Fixed-peak trials confirm that increasing ON-time (thus mean) reintroduces the vortex. Shortcomings: I still need finer peak-threshold mapping and a frequency sweep. Current position: map minimum peak at 25% duty, then vary frequency around 5 Hz.
openQuestion: At 25% duty and 5 Hz, what is the minimum peak flow required to suppress the 15 cm anchored recirculation?
